newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Hilti sales rise 22 pct in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Hilti sales rise 22 pct in early 1997.

text.p: Specialty construction equipment maker Hilti AG said sales for the first four months of this year rose 22 percent.

"In the first four months of the current business year, Hilti achieved sales growth of 22 percent in Swiss francs (10 percent in local currencies) compared to the same period last year," a company statement said.
Hilti added that severe winter conditions in Europe and North America in early 1996 had impact on last year's comparison period.
"In the current business year activity in the construction industries of Germany, Austria and Switzerland continue to slow or decline," the statement said.
However, Hilti said good growth was anticipated this year in Asia, Southern Europe, Eastern Europe and Latin America. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
